series.definition: USGS Data Series 140. Native United States column: Petroleum coke. Table unit statement: [All values in metric tons]. Source workbook: ds140-organ.xlsx; worksheet: Nonrenewable organics. A United States series is one country’s history, not worldwide country coverage.
series.reporting_period: Annual publisher calendar-year table; retained workbook vintage

source_table_notes.value: 1Compiled by T.D. Kelly (retired) and G. Matos.
Data are estimated, calculated, or reported.  See notes for more information.

limitations: United States source observations and publisher world totals are separate datasets; a world total is never assigned to individual countries.

Native units, quantities, monetary unit values, source text, unavailable cells and source notes remain attached. No numerical unit conversion, interpolation, carry-forward, zero filling, summation or recalculation is performed.
A workbook is a retained publication vintage. Publisher estimates, apparent-consumption calculations and inflation adjustments retain their original source meaning; these are not new model results.

Blank, NA, W, footnote-only and other nonnumeric cells remain unavailable rather than zero. Workbook-wide and table notes may qualify multiple observations; the absence of a cell flag does not establish a directly measured value.
Calendar years and geography follow this source. Boundaries, reporting methods, physical forms and coverage may change; compare the exact native column definition and notes.
Physical quantities and nominal or 1998-dollar unit values are different columns. The constant-dollar calculation was made by the publisher and is not recomputed here.
